channel.title: P.S. 165Q · Shooting Stars News
channel.description: News, calendar updates, and highlights from P.S. 165Q Edith K. Bergtraum School in Flushing, Queens.

item.title: Spring Concert lights up the auditorium
item.description: Grades 3–5 took the stage for our annual Spring Concert — a celebration of music, movement, and months of hard work.

item.title: NEST students take home district honors at the STEM Fair
item.description: Three NEST teams placed in the District 25 STEM Fair, with a fourth-grade project on bird migration earning Best in Show.

item.title: Pre-K and Kindergarten enrollment open for 2026–2027
item.description: Applications for 3-K, Pre-K, and Kindergarten are open through the NYC DOE MySchools portal. Tours run monthly.
